Title: Support for multiple node pools in Azure Kubernetes Service is now available

Body.Content:
Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) support for multiple node pools, now generally available, allows you to use different virtual machines sizes in each pool to run various workloads in a single AKS cluster. The feature is designed to help you better manage compute resources. For example, an e-commerce website could have a node pool for billing service and another for machine-learning based recommendation service, each with potentially different virtual machine types. 

Learn more
